summary: Implemented the two-track asset admission module (T025) and its P02 closeout report. The module consumes the T022 PoolRegistry, T023 EligibilityDecision per pool, and T024 ChainCapabilityReport and emits a per-(chain, PoolKey) PoolAdmissionRecord with Track A (technical admission, deterministic from T022+T023+T024 evidence) and Track B (operator admission, pending_owner by default until an explicit OperatorDecision arrives). Track A is fail-closed with precedence: capability_report_missing -> bytecode_drift -> proxy_detected -> hook_bytecode_unavailable -> eligibility_level=rejected -> admitted. The P02 closeout report computes the three P02 README exit-gate conditions: two_provider_agreement (from ChainCapabilityReport.cross_endpoint), deployment_report_passed (from ChainCapabilityReport.passed and empty errors), every_pool_has_support_reason (every PoolRecord has a non-empty T023 EligibilityDecision.reasons list). Track B does NOT directly promote live; the live_block field is always None in this attempt (G-LIVE-GATE-01 territory, out of scope for T025). The OperatorDecision dataclass is supplied by callers — T025 does NOT mint synthetic Owner decisions. It does not block T025 acceptance. test_abi_artifacts.py shows 1 failed / 33 passed — matches the T023 baseline.

T025 introduces the OperatorDecision dataclass but does NOT define the OwnerDecision workflow route itself. Track B remains pending_owner by default; the OwnerDecision artifact format and the workflow route that produces it are separate concerns (T041 / T070 territory). Track B does NOT directly promote live; the live_block field is always None in T025.

The asset_admission module consumes T023 EligibilityReasonCode.PROXY_DETECTED rather than re-detecting the EIP-1167 minimal-proxy pattern itself. This is deliberate — T025 is the audit-trail layer (per docs/spec/product/ASSET_ADMISSION.md §4); evidence-fetch and re-classification belong to T022-T024. If T023 adds new rejection reason codes in a future revision, the Track A precedence list in asset_admission._compute_track_a must be revised in the same attempt to preserve audit-trail accuracy.

The asset_admission module does NOT itself fetch bytecode or probe chain capabilities; it consumes the pinned T022 registry, T023 decisions, and T024 capability report as inputs. This is intentional and matches the ADR-006 storage-layer boundary.

P02 closeout report's generated_at field uses datetime.now(UTC); the to_dict output is byte-identical across runs only when generated_at is pinned (verified by test_closeout_report_to_dict_is_deterministic_excluding_timestamp). The intended use is one report per P02 closeout event; callers that need to compare reports across runs should pin or normalise the timestamp.

DEFAULT_DECODE_RULE_VERSION is a string constant capturing the T022/T023/T024 binding; future T022/T023/T024 revisions must update this constant in the same attempt to keep the audit trail accurate. The constant is recorded on every PoolAdmissionRecord so the audit trail is self-describing.
